title: gjc gc --disk --prune blob mark/sweep reclaims a blob while a transcript keeps changing under the mark
summary: The blob mark/sweep drift fence is racy: when a session transcript keeps changing while the mark runs, `gjc gc --disk --prune` can converge on stale evidence and reclaim a blob as `unreferenced_by_any_surviving_session` instead of withholding the sweep with `keep:withheld_evidence_incomplete: sessions_changed_during_mark`. A reference appended after the last drift check (or during the mark's own read) is invisible to the sweep, so reclamation can destroy evidence a live transcript still points at.

surfacedBy.failingTest: gjc gc --disk --prune (blob mark and sweep) > withholds the sweep when a transcript keeps changing under the mark

attribution.conclusion: pre-existing race in dev's GC mark/sweep; PR #4149 did not introduce it
evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/gjc-runtime/gc-runtime.ts is byte-identical between e5ff1c1 and dev HEAD
packages/coding-agent/test/gc-disk-retention.test.ts is byte-identical between e5ff1c1 and dev HEAD
the #4149 branch diff (e5ff1c1..5dafea1c) touches zero GC files
the test fails on exact dev d73bc90ae4, #4149 base e5ff1c1, and dev HEAD alike
the mark/sweep drift fence shipped in feat(gc): add an opt-in disk-retention pass (#4037), hardened by #4084 and #4110; the drift window survived all three

rootCauseHypothesis.theDriftCheckIsAStatAfterTheRead: markGcDiskTranscript reads the transcript first and lstats it after; a change landing between the end of the read and the lstat records a stat NEWER than the bytes read, so the drift comparison sees no change even though the reference set is stale.
rootCauseHypothesis.theSweepIsNotFencedAgainstTheLastDriftCh: once findGcDiskMarkDrift returns empty, the loop breaks and the sweep runs; any append that lands after that final walk (or during the walk itself, after the file was visited) is never compared, so the sweep can reclaim a blob whose only reference appeared in the changed tail.
rootCauseHypothesis.result: a transcript that keeps changing under the mark can converge to clean evidence and have its blobs reclaimed as unreferenced_by_any_surviving_session.

safetyRequirement: A blob whose only live reference could be held by a transcript that changed at any point while the mark or sweep was measuring the store must never be reclaimed: partial or stale evidence withholds the sweep, exactly as the `sessions_changed_during_mark` path intends.
